target: ANEF empty-overlay fall-through: _build_environmental._anef_field short-circuited to a blank postgis_overlays value whenever 'anef' was in covered_layers, never consulting the working anef_zones live query.
findings_summary: Verified live against the production DB: fetch_anef_zone returns the real Sydney contour (Mascot -33.927/151.206 -> ANEF 35; Haberfield -> ANEF 30) but the full brief returned anef.value=null, source=postgis_overlays. Root cause at intelligence_brief.py:2057 — `if "anef" in covered: return DataField(value=anef_value, source=postgis_overlays)`. anef_value (line 2118) is the value of an overlay row with layer_type=='anef', which is None for most lots even though the LGA's anef layer is listed as covered. So the covered-check short-circuited before fetch_anef_zone. Fix: guard the short-circuit with `and anef_value is not None` so an empty overlay falls through to the live anef_zones query (then regional fetch_anef, then the honest 'no published contour'). Behaviour when the overlay HAS a value is unchanged. Two regression tests added to tests/test_overlay_live_fallback.py (empty-covered falls through to anef_zones; valued-covered still wins, anef_zones not consulted). No DB write, no migration, no new source. GO.
